Extract variances of random terms

Source: R/pglmm-utils.R
VarCorr.Rd

Extract the variances of random terms

Usage

# S3 method for class 'communityPGLMM'
VarCorr(x, sigma = 1, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted model with class communityPGLMM.

sigma

Ignored.

...

Ignored.

Value

A data frame with one row for each random term (and the residual for gaussian models), with columns Variance and Std.Dev.

Details

Extract the estimated variances (and standard deviations) of the random terms from a fitted model. For Bayesian models, the credible intervals of the variances are also returned. Use ranef() to get the estimates for each level of the random terms.

Before version 1.4.0, this table was returned by ranef().

The variances are the elements s2r, s2n and s2resid of the fitted model. The variance of a term with a covariance matrix (e.g. a phylogenetic term such as 1|sp__) is on the scale of that matrix after it was standardized to have a determinant of one, which is usually much smaller than the scale of the phylogenetic correlation matrix, whereas terms without a covariance matrix (e.g. 1|sp) and the residual are not affected. The variances of different terms are therefore not directly comparable. Multiply them by scale_factors of the fitted model before comparing terms or comparing with other software (see "Extracting the variances of random terms" in the Details of pglmm(), and the examples below).

See also

ranef() for the estimates of each level of the random terms.

Examples

# community data: abundance of each species at each site
dat <- data.frame(
  site = rep(rownames(comm_a), times = ncol(comm_a)),
  sp = rep(colnames(comm_a), each = nrow(comm_a)),
  freq = unlist(comm_a, use.names = FALSE)
)
dat$shade <- envi$shade[match(dat$site, envi$site)]
phy <- ape::keep.tip(phylotree, unique(dat$sp))
fit <- pglmm(freq ~ shade + (1 | sp__) + (1 | site),
  data = dat, cov_ranef = list(sp = phy)
)

VarCorr(fit)
#>           Variance   Std.Dev
#> 1|sp     0.0000000 0.0000000
#> 1|sp__   0.7748109 0.8802334
#> 1|site   0.0000000 0.0000000
#> residual 3.2656287 1.8071051
# variances on a comparable scale: rescale the terms whose covariance
# matrices were standardized (the phylogenetic term here)
v <- VarCorr(fit)
sf <- ifelse(rownames(v) == "residual", 1, fit$scale_factors[rownames(v)])
setNames(v$Variance * sf, rownames(v))
#>     1|sp   1|sp__   1|site residual 
#> 0.000000 1.172953 0.000000 3.265629 
# proportion of the variance among species that is phylogenetic
v_sp <- v[c("1|sp", "1|sp__"), "Variance"] * fit$scale_factors[c("1|sp", "1|sp__")]
v_sp[2] / sum(v_sp)
#> 1|sp__ 
#>      1
